name: Famine
overview: Scripture reveals famine as a severe and widespread hardship marked by scarcity of food and resources, as seen in the grievous famine during Abraham's time and another in Isaac's days. The account of Joseph in Egypt illustrates God's providential preparation through seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine, during which Egypt was spared while other lands suffered. This demonstrates both the reality of famine as a divine judgment and the faithful provision for the righteous amid crisis.
